goal: Allow Linux release binaries to run on non-glibc distributions like Alpine and on older systems
Avoid compatibility loaders on NixOS and lay groundwork for aarch64 pointer authentication
agreement: Unaddressed objection: static glibc breaks when dynamic NSS resolvers load mismatched host libraries (luke-jr)
Strong support and verification across Alpine, NixOS, Fedora, Arch, and older Ubuntu (jsarenik, 0xB10C, hebasto)
Prefers static glibc over musl as a more palatable and auditable approach (theuni)
Open suggestion to add diagnostic logging when NSS resolution fails (xrviv)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it allows official release binaries to run across non-glibc distributions and older systems
Eliminates the need for custom compatibility shims or loaders on systems like Alpine and NixOS
Lays groundwork for future security mitigations such as aarch64 pointer authentication
